# m.partners.fable.merchant_hierarchy

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Fable Data's map from merchants to parent companies, tickers, and industries.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.partners.fable.merchant_hierarchy(*, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `LookupName` and `ActiveFrom`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Massive's field to sort by, such as `"lookup_name"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Such as `{"listing_status": "public"}`. Keys: `active_from`, `active_from_gt`, `active_from_gte`, `active_from_lt`, `active_from_lte`, `active_to`, `active_to_gt`, `active_to_gte`, `active_to_lt`, `active_to_lte`, `listing_status`, `listing_status_any_of`, `lookup_name`, `lookup_name_any_of`, `lookup_name_gt`, `lookup_name_gte`, `lookup_name_lt`, `lookup_name_lte`, `ticker`, `ticker_any_of`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Merchant Hierarchy (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| European Consumer Spending by Merchant | 30-day delayed, All history |
| European Consumer Spending by Merchant Business | 7-day delayed, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ActiveFrom` | String | Date this merchant hierarchy mapping became applicable. A value of 0001-01-01 indicates no known start date. Use with active_to to match against transaction_date from the merchant-aggregates endpoint to perform point-in-time queries. |
| `ActiveTo` | String | Date after which this merchant hierarchy mapping is no longer applicable due to a corporate action. A value of 9999-12-31 indicates the mapping is currently active. |
| `Category` | String | Merchant category assigned by the data provider (Title Case, e.g., 'Groceries', 'General Merchandise', 'Travel'). Values are managed by the data provider and may expand over time. |
| `GrandparentName` | String | Merchant's grandparent business name (Title Case). |
| `GrandparentTicker` | String | Stock ticker of the merchant's grandparent company. Uses Bloomberg standard. |
| `GreatGrandparentName` | String | Merchant's great-grandparent business name (Title Case, top-level corporate entity). |
| `GreatGrandparentTicker` | String | Stock ticker of the merchant's great-grandparent company (top-level corporate entity). Uses Bloomberg standard. |
| `Industry` | String | Industry classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards. |
| `IndustryGroup` | String | Industry group classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards. |
| `ListingStatus` | String | Whether the merchant is a publicly listed company or private. Possible values: public, private. |
| `LookupName` | String | Lowercase merchant tag used for joining with the merchant-aggregates endpoint name field (e.g., 'asda', 'amazon'). |
| `NormalizedName` | String | Cleaned, standardized merchant display name (Title Case, e.g., 'Asda', 'Amazon'). |
| `ParentName` | String | Merchant's parent business name (Title Case). Useful for aggregating transactions across subsidiary brands. |
| `ParentTicker` | String | Stock ticker of the merchant's parent company. Uses Bloomberg standard. |
| `Sector` | String | Sector classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards. |
| `SubIndustry` | String | Sub-industry classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards. |
| `Ticker` | String | Stock ticker associated with the merchant (~250 US public companies mapped). Uses Bloomberg standard. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
